mostWorthwhile.text: Building the membrane patch was most worthwhile: the heads and tails lining up made its structure understandable, and the result explained why oxygen could cross.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the water channel was fairly predictable from its picture and the goal, although seeing the pore span the membrane was clear.

surprise.text: Oxygen crossed both ways, with more entering; I had expected it to move only into the cell.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but the final item’s name leaves it unclear whether the water channel remains in that particular picture, despite the goal being completed.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: seeing the membrane pieces form different routes was clear and interesting, though the compatible-pair menu made the choices fairly straightforward.
